sentences.text: The Colony is a new city.
The ground outside is red sand.
Today, Jax and Lina go outside.
They walk on the red sand.
It is a big black door.
It is not a human door.
The path is long and dark.
They are in a very big room.
The city is under the ground.
The buildings are tall and black.
Blue lights are on the buildings.
This is not a human city.
Jax and Lina are in shock.
What is the real story of Mars?

questions.text: Where do Jax and Lina live?
